method: Recover the two marked Q1920 groups from the complete local degree-at-most-twelve census. Compute all irreducible F3[Q] modules, their image orders and absolute irreducibility, and the common fixed-space dimensions of the two marked radial S3 subgroups A and B.
consequence: A nonzero A-fixed vector can lie in faithful Q1920 irreducible modules of dimensions 6, 10, and 24. Therefore the z-generated A5 span and minimal L-chief irreducibility do not force the whole chief factor to have dimension four.
scope: This is an exact local representation-theoretic fence. It does not test the collision involution on the higher-dimensional modules.
